title: pricing-packaging-scratchpad-v3
content:
Goal: quick back-of-envelope to sanity-check per-token pricing, tier ideas, and break-even for Redwood Hosted and Dedicated. Informal notes - lots of approximations, TODOs inline.

Assumptions (baseline)
- Avg request length (prompt): 80 tokens
- Avg generation per request: 120 tokens
- Total tokens per request = 200 tokens (round)
- Req/sec per active seat (interactive chat): 0.05 rps (~3 reqs/min) -> ~36 reqs/hour -> baseline daily usage varies widely
- Monthly active minutes per user (MAU_active): 1,500 min (~25 hrs/month) -> rough active user
- Requests/month/user: if 3 reqs/min * 1500 min = 4,500 reqs -> tokens/month/user = 4,500 * 200 = 900k tokens

Cost assumptions (hosted)
- Model serving cost (infrastructure + amortized GPU + infra ops): ~ $0.0000008 per token for big LLM (7B-13B q4-ish) - placeholder
- Storage / embeddings / index cost per user (monthly): $0.50 (small)
- Overhead (SRE, infra, monitoring, amortized): add 10% on top of token cost
- Customer support + margin target: want 60% gross margin on hosted product

Unit economics calc (hosted)
- Raw cost per token = 0.0000008 -> per-month cost/user = 900,000 * 0.0000008 = $0.72
- + storage $0.50 = $1.22
- + 10% overhead -> $1.34 cost/month/user
- To hit 60% gross margin, price = cost / (1 - margin) = 1.34 / 0.4 = $3.35/month -> suggests a low tier at $3.5/mo for light users (900k tokens/month)

Model tiers thought
- Free tier: 200k tokens/month (low usage), restrict to smaller model (2-4B), limited concurrency.
- Starter ($3.5/mo): 900k tokens/month (baseline above) - includes small model and hosted quota.
- Growth ($29/mo): 10M tokens/mo -> cost = 10M * .0000008 = $8 + storage/overhead -> ~$12 cost -> price $29 gives ~58% margin.
- Team ($199/mo): 100M tokens/mo -> raw cost $80 -> +overhead $90 -> price $199 -> margin target ~55-60% but also includes analytics and support.
- Enterprise: custom pricing, reserved capacity (Dedicated) with committed discounts and SLA.

Dedicated/reserved back-of-envelope
- For Dedicated, upstream GPU cost amortized per token drops significantly if utilization high. Example: p4d-like cluster cost (after discount) -> $X/hr leading to per-token cost estimate for heavy workloads ~ $0.00000025/token.
- Break-even commit: if customer uses > Y tokens/month then Dedicated becomes cheaper. Rough threshold: compare hosted per-token $0.0000008 vs dedicated $0.00000025 -> ~3.2x reduction.

Sensitivity / sanity checks
- If avg tokens/user/month is lower (e.g., 200k), starter price of $3.5 is too high -> consider metered pay-as-you-go overlay or prorated credits.
- Latency/cost trade: we can upsell lower-latency tiers (reserved concurrency / dedicated) at premium.
- Embeddings-heavy apps: embedding cost separate (higher per-call cost) and should be a separate SKU or add-on.

Open questions / TODOs
- Need more accurate per-token cost by model family (7B vs 13B vs 70B) and quantization variant (q4 vs q8). Hook to infra cost model (infra team).
- Provide example customer profiles: chatbot (high small requests), summarization (large outputs), embeddings (many small calls). Compute per-profile $/MAU.
- Think about combo pricing: monthly seat + token pool vs strictly metered.
- What free quota to give to encourage trials but avoid abuse? 50k tokens/month? 200k? experiment.
- Add rate limiting tiers and concurrency limits as part of plan differentiation.

Strawman feature mapping to plans
- Free: small model only, 1 concurrent session, 200k tokens/mo, community support.
- Starter: 3B-7B models, low concurrency, basic analytics, $/mo above.
- Growth: higher model options, more tokens, longer retention in Console, custom eval set support.
- Team: access to fine-tuning/evals, higher SLA, rollouts, larger token pool.
- Enterprise: Dedicated/private options + signed SLA + SOC/ISO artifacts.

Notes from earlier discussions: Samir suggested basing price on cost per 1M tokens to make it intuitive ("$X per 1M tokens") + monthly seat for teams. Jordan prefers bundles (seat + token pool).

Quick examples to share in pitch slide (round numbers)
- 1M tokens @ hosted cost = 1M * 0.0000008 = $0.80 raw -> price $2.00 (profit + overhead) -> $2/1M as a unit price suggestion for entry model.
- 10M tokens hosted raw = $8 -> price $20-30.

Next steps
- Ask infra for per-model per-token cost table (q2) -> Jira ticket PRIC-58.
- Run customer usage histogram to understand percentile consumption (product/analytics).
- Build a calculator (sheet) to iterate scenarios and publish internal guidance.

Rough/rough - use this as conversation starter.
